articles.title: Besiktas v Hapoel with lengthy interruption due to riots in the stands
articles.description: The Europa League match between Turkey's Besiktas and Israel's Hapoel Be'er-Sheva on Thursday was interrupted for a lengthy period due to serious disturbances in the stands. The game had been moved to Batumi, Georgia, due to security concerns related to the Gaza War.
